title: Fretboard Note Trainer
summary: Name the note under a marker, find every position of a named note, or pick up the guitar and play it — the microphone checks you. Filter by string, fret range and note. Tap anything to hear it; finish a round and it plays every position from low to high. Tracks accuracy, streaks, average time and which notes you keep missing.

title: Ear Trainer
summary: Four drills: intervals, hear-it-then-find-it on the fretboard, chord quality, and scale degrees against an established key. Synth or recorded acoustic guitar. Per-drill stats so you can see which intervals and chords you actually can't hear yet.

title: How to Practise This — what the evidence says
summary: A review of the learning-science literature applied to fretboard training: how long a session, how many a day, how many notes at once, and how to space them. Includes the things that get repeated constantly and have failed to replicate. Every claim graded, every N given.
